title: Efficacy of Loperamide for C. Difficile Colitis and Other Diarrheal Diseases Associated With Antibiotic Therapy
brief_summary: To determine whether symptomatic treatment of the diarrhea in CDAD reduces morbidity and mortality of this serious nosocomial infection in patients who have antibiotic-associated diarrhea. Both C. diff positive and negative patients will be included.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with diarrheal stools considered to be antibiotic associated

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability of sign consent
* Patient with other known gastrointestinal disease
* Patients receiving tube feeding or fecal incontinence prior to receiving antibiotics
